summary: A parent or student speaks of a school cut as something the board chose.
realLife: At a packed board meeting over a large shortfall, speakers made personal appeals: a student pleaded to keep a program she had worked at for years, a library media specialist called a staffing cut harmful, a parent said cutting social workers does not fix the budget. Students gathered outside. They talked as if the cuts were a decision the board made.
sources: https://www.kctv5.com/2026/11/10/blue-valley-students-parents-raise-concerns-about-proposed-cuts-art-classes-school-services/ (local TV report on a school board budget meeting)
gates: a school in the speaker's household has a program on the cut list
the district budget line for schools falls or is proposed to fall
weights: how close the speaker is to the program
whether the speaker has heard the board's reason
how much a household pays for the program's supplies
inGame: reads the school budget line and the household's tie to the program; needs: a household record of which school program a child is in

turns.turn: the parent says what she would cut instead
turns.what: She names a different line and says the board should pick that.
turns.pulledBy: she has read the budget and heard the district's side
turns.writesBack: her stand on the budget line gets a reason that cites the shortfall

turns.what: She says it hurts but the money is not there.
turns.pulledBy: a neighbor on the board explained the shortfall to her
turns.writesBack: the stand changes to resigned; no testimony given

turns.turn: the speaker goes quiet at home
turns.what: She tells her spouse it is decided and does not go back.
turns.writesBack: she is marked as withdrawn from the school's meetings
